issues.description: The Person.firstName attribute has inconsistent types between the template and the solution. In the template repository Person.firstName is declared as String, which matches the getter/setter signatures and the problem intent, but in the solution repository Person.firstName is declared as int. This mismatch will cause compilation errors (getters/setters and equals/hashCode expect Strings) and prevents students from building or running the provided solution, creating significant confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Person.firstName declaration in the solution repository to String to match the template and getter/setter signatures (private String firstName;), ensuring equals/hashCode and all methods consistently use String for firstName so the project compiles and the model matches the exercise description.
